say:1:1631858001:1.text: Those terrifying eagles, those creepy snakes... and wolves like you.
say:1:1631858001:1.source_cn: 可怕的鹰，吓人的蛇，还有你这样的狼。
say:1:1631858001:1.male: Those terrifying eagles, those creepy snakes... and wolves like you.
say:1:1631858001:1.female: Those terrifying eagles, those creepy snakes... and wolves like you.

say:2:1631858002:1.text: I mean, anything big out in the wild scares the life out of me now.

say:2:1631858002:1.male: I mean, anything big out in the wild scares the life out of me now.

say:5:1631858004:1.text: I'm afraid I've gotten too used to turning into a squirrel.
